name: nvidia/cosmos3-h-dreams
title: NVIDIA releases new open model families at GTC Berlin, including Nemotron 3.5, Kumo tabular models and Cosmos 3.5
summary: NVIDIA announced new open models for language and vision (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt, Nemotron Retriever), structured business data (the Kumo family and Kumo Engine library), robotics and driving (Cosmos 3.5, Alpamayo 2 Edge), biology and quantum computing, including a real-time surgical world model on Hugging Face, for teams that want to fine-tune and host on their own infrastructure.
